description: Royal Match-style shell for areas 1-5: home screen, areas list, area task page, level start popup and in-level HUD. The board, pieces, animation, VFX and the 1209 tuned levels are kept exactly as they are. Reference screenshots and the list of what differs from the kit are in docs/royal-match/.

userStories.title: Royal Match panel and button primitives in StoryUi
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the shared shapes every Royal Match screen is built from, so the later screens are assembly rather than invention.
acceptanceCriteria: StoryUi gains: RoyalPanel(title) - a blue panel with a gold rim, a title plate and a red round close X in the top-right corner
StoryUi gains: GreenButton(label) and a small star-cost badge widget
StoryUi gains: TopBar() - a strip with coins, lives, stars and a settings gear, reading live values from StoryProgress where they exist
Colours and proportions are taken from docs/royal-match/02-area-tasks.jpg and 10-level-start-popup.jpg
A scratch scene or a self-test logs one line per primitive proving it constructs without error
Typecheck passes: python3 tools/make_typecheck_csproj.py && dotnet build Story.Typecheck.csproj -v q --nologo reports 0 Error(s)
python3 tools/check_vfx_intact.py reports no regressions

userStories.title: Level HUD: Target and Moves, no score bar
userStories.description: As a player, I want the level HUD to be target plus moves, because Royal Match has no score bar and no star rating inside a level.
acceptanceCriteria: A StoryLevelHud component replaces the kit's score/star bar with three panels: Target (icons + counts) on the left, a portrait slot centre, Moves on the right
The kit's ProgressBarScript object is hidden, not deleted
Target icons come from the level's Target assets; counts update as the target is collected
Moves shows LevelManager.THIS.Limit and updates every move
Matches the layout in docs/royal-match/11-level-hud.jpg
Verify in the Unity Editor: enter Play mode and confirm the change from a Game-view screenshot and from [Story] lines in Logs/Editor.log
Typecheck passes: python3 tools/make_typecheck_csproj.py && dotnet build Story.Typecheck.csproj -v q --nologo reports 0 Error(s)
python3 tools/check_vfx_intact.py reports no regressions

userStories.title: End-to-end self-test for areas 1 to 5
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the first five areas proven in play mode rather than asserted.
acceptanceCriteria: A StoryShellTest component, in the shape of StoryPowerupTest, that runs itself once per play session
It walks areas 1-5: opens each area page, counts tasks, grants the needed stars, buys every repair, and confirms the area reports restored
It logs one PASS/FAIL line per area plus a summary line
It uses no UnityEngine.Input and no synthetic clicks
All five areas report PASS
